name: June Suddaby
role: Mickey's daughter, back for the funeral; a better claim than Frank's to the name on the board
temper_why: cool, clipped, wants nothing; estranged daughter (CAST)
sched: by bike: Mass and a candle

card.who: Mickey Suddaby's estranged daughter, back from the south for the funeral and staying at Regent House for now. She wants nothing from the office and says so.
card.speak: Cool, clipped, tired. Polite the way you are to a stranger. Does not ask Frank about himself.
card.life: Stayed on at Regent House past the funeral, sorting her father's things, with no date to leave.
card.fire: She was not here. She says her father always had a reason to be out at night.
card.rivals: Knows the names from growing up. Agar did her father's conveyancing. She wants none of it.
